# Data Formats Reference

JSON schemas for positions, moves, and search/hint options—used consistently across the CLI (`--state`, `--json`, `serve`), WebAssembly/JS, Python, and C ABI.

## Position (`StateData`)

A position keyed by group name. Each group is a list of piles, each pile a list of cards bottom first, written like `"AS"`, `"10H"` or `"~KC"` (face down).

```json { "piles": { "tableau": [["~5H", "KS"], ["QD"]], "foundation": [[], [], [], []] } } ```

Groups left out are empty.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base_rank` | `integer` \| `null` | — |  |
| `piles` *(required)* | Record&lt;string, `string`[][]&gt; | — |  |
| `redeals_used` | `integer` | — |  |
| `seed` | `integer` | — | Seed for shuffles during play (shuffling redeals). Part of the deal. |

## Move / Action (`Step`)

One step of a solution, as a player would make it. Automatic actions (turning up exposed cards, refilling from a reserve) follow each step and aren't listed.

- `{ "type": ... }` (`"deal"`) — Deal from the stock.
- `{ "type": ... }` (`"redeal"`) — Turn the waste back over to form a new stock.
- `{ "count", "from", "to", "type": "move" }` — Move `count` cards from the top of `from` onto `to`.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` *(required)* | `integer` | — |  |
| `from` *(required)* | [PileRef](#step-pileref) | — |  |
| `to` *(required)* | [PileRef](#step-pileref) | — |  |
| `type` *(required)* | `"move"` | — |  |

- `{ "piles", "type": "remove" }` — Remove the top cards of these piles.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `piles` *(required)* | [PileRef](#step-pileref)[] | — |  |
| `type` *(required)* | `"remove"` | — |  |


### PileRef {#step-pileref}

A pile, named by its group and its index within the group (from 0).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` *(required)* | `string` | — |  |
| `index` *(required)* | `integer` | — |  |

## Search Options (`SolveOptions`)

Search limits and knobs.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `autoplay` | `boolean` | `true` | Play provably safe foundation moves automatically (when the rules allow it). |
| `max_states` | `integer` | `2000000` | Stop after visiting this many distinct positions. |
| `shorten` | `boolean` | `true` | Shorten winning lines by cutting out detours (default true). |
| `strategy` | [Strategy](#solve-strategy) | `"auto"` |  |
| `timeout_ms` | `integer` \| `null` | — | Stop after this many milliseconds of wall-clock time (native targets only). |

### Strategy {#solve-strategy}

Search strategy.

- `"depth_first"` — Depth-first, heuristic ordering. Can prove unsolvability.
- `"best_first"` — Best-first by heuristic. Can also prove unsolvability, at a higher memory cost.
- `"auto"` — Best-first for a share of the budget, then depth-first with the rest.

## Hint Options (`HintOptions`)

Hint settings.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `samples` | `integer` | `16` | Random guesses at the hidden cards (ignored when nothing is hidden). |
| `seed` | `integer` | `0` |  |
| `solve` | [SolveOptions](#hint-solveoptions) | *standard default* | Search options for each guess. Its `max_states` is the budget for each guess. |
